The '''Ribenboim Prize''', named in honour of [[Paulo Ribenboim]], is awarded by the Canadian Number Theory Association for distinguished research in [[number theory]] by a mathematician who is Canadian or has close connections to Canadian mathematics.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ucalgary.ca/cnta2016/ribenboim-prize|title=Ribenboim Prize – Canadian Number Theory Association CNTA XIV – University of Calgary|website=www.ucalgary.ca}}</ref>  Normally, the winner will have received their Ph.D. in the last 12 years. The winner is expected to give a plenary talk at the award ceremony.<ref name="ulaval.ca">{{cite web|url=https://archimede.mat.ulaval.ca/CNTA2018/|title=Canadian Number Theory Association CNTA XV|website=archimede.mat.ulaval.ca|access-date=2019-03-07|archive-date=2019-02-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190203060251/https://archimede.mat.ulaval.ca/CNTA2018/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], the 2020, 2022, and 2024 Ribenboim Prizes were all awarded in 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fields.utoronto.ca/activities/23-24/CNTA-XVI|title=Canadian Number Theory Association XVI}}</ref>
